gaps.G1: No persisted per-account session generation or equivalent revocation check in any local bearer verifier. Disabled/enabled and role checks cannot revoke a signed token permanently.
gaps.G2: Flag-off branch skips current disabled/role/scope checks or substitutes wildcard admin. Session validity and privileged role checks must apply in both flag states.
gaps.G3: resolveScope/assertEnabledAccount/assertRole cache account state for 30 seconds. Invalidation tickets protect in-flight loads, but are not a durable session revocation barrier.
gaps.G4: Authorization before queued SQL, async work, writer acquisition or delayed physical dispatch does not prove current rights at apply time. Carry validated session identity and recheck at the final boundary.
gaps.G5: Device-owner SQL or ownedValve still refuses a zone grantee after a successful scope check (#451). Remove only after replacing it with current authorized resource targeting.
gaps.G6: No installer entitlement exists. Current network/radio gates admit ordinary scoped users or admins; hiding the GUI alone cannot enforce installer-only tools.
gaps.G7: Cloud command identity/current-role enforcement is incomplete: REGISTER_DEVICE, generic system commands, valve schedule helpers and scoped-user/grant mutations need EB5a audit. Cloud transport authority does not prove actor authority.
gaps.G8: No durable link incarnation/independent credential revision fences unlink/relink. v1 linked change repeats verifier version 1; edge can replace different verifier at equal version; unlink resets version. Delayed delivery can restore prior credentials/binding. Transport-subject disable can strand even an online revocation.
gaps.G9: Browser session epoch isolates client caches after observed logout/401; it is neither server revocation nor push notification. An idle tab can retain its stored token.
gaps.G11: Edge GET /api/users lists accounts without grant assignments; no GET grant directory exists at this pin. The entire account/grant router is 404 with scoped access off, so Admin cannot inspect/revoke existing grants in every mode.
gaps.G10: Some verifiers allow absent/zero expiry or treat exp equality as valid. K1 requires bounded expiry and rejection at now >= exp.
gaps.G12: Public feature discovery, account-wide measurement export, ownerless legacy today-liters read and writer-only valve list have different admission paths; shared route groups cannot describe them as one bearer/scope gate.

cloud_baseline_deltas.capability_source_required: Edge-confirmed scoped support for current installation/link incarnation; no caller-link inference.
cloud_baseline_deltas.legacy_fallback_required: Explicitly confirmed legacy gateway only, owner-scoped and mapped enabled writer; unknown support refuses, never owner shortcut.

cloud_baseline_deltas.legacy_fallback_required: Only positively known legacy mode, never missing/stale/unknown capability; current mapped enabled writer and ownership still required.

cloud_baseline_deltas.capability_source_required: Same gateway-bound mode/capability record as physical authorizer.
